about.title: Dedicated to Protection and Service
about.subtitle: The Karnataka State Police is committed to maintaining law and order, preventing crime, and ensuring the safety and security of all citizens across the state.
about.missionDesc: To protect life and property, prevent crime, maintain public order, and uphold the rule of law with professionalism, integrity, and respect for human rights.
about.visionDesc: A safe and secure Karnataka where citizens feel protected, crime is proactively prevented through technology, and police services are accessible, transparent, and citizen-friendly.
about.valuesDesc: Integrity, professionalism, compassion, transparency, and community partnership guide every action of the Karnataka State Police force.

news.title: Latest Police News
news.subtitle: Stay informed with the latest updates, press releases, and announcements from the Karnataka State Police.
news.item1Title: KSP Launches AI-Powered Crime Prediction System
news.item1Desc: Karnataka State Police unveils state-of-the-art artificial intelligence system for predictive crime mapping across Bengaluru urban and rural districts.
news.item2Title: Traffic Awareness Campaign Begins in All Districts
news.item2Desc: State-wide road safety awareness campaign 'Suraksha Karnataka' launched with focus on helmet compliance, seatbelt usage, and drunk driving prevention.
news.item3Title: Cyber Crime Wing Nabs International Hacking Ring
news.item3Desc: KSP Cyber Crime Division successfully dismantles an international phishing ring operating across three states, arresting 12 suspects.
news.item4Desc: Chief Minister announces 'Nirbhaya Karnataka' program with 500 new CCTV cameras, dedicated women helpline vans, and self-defense training in colleges.

testimonials.title: What Citizens Say
testimonials.quote1: The E-FIR system is incredibly convenient. I registered my complaint online and got the FIR number within hours without visiting the station.
testimonials.quote2: KSP's traffic app helped me pay my challan online quickly. The entire process was seamless and transparent.
testimonials.quote3: The lost and found portal reunited me with my documents within a week. Thank you Karnataka Police for this excellent service.

helplines.title: Need Help? Call Us
